result.summary: The environment is characterized by a wide, newly paved roadway lacking any visible traffic control devices or pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk exists on one side, it is in fair condition and bordered by overgrown vegetation that may impact visibility at the intersection.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks stop signs, signals, or marked crosswalks, creating high risk for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the two roads meet

hazards.name: Lack of Lane Markings
hazards.description: The newly paved road lacks lane markings, which can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the background

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Overgrown vegetation on the left corner may block the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the 'Vacant Lot' sign

interventions.title: High-Visibility Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Traffic Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or appropriate traffic signals to manage vehicle flow and provide gaps for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and a wide grassy median. While a crossing is provided, it lacks active controls like signals or signs, and the pedestrian infrastructure on the right side is unpaved and lacks accessible curb ramps.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a signal or stop sign, increasing the risk of multiple-threat crashes.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The white van parked on the left side of the road near the crosswalk obscures the sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Accessible Infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of paved sidewalks and curb ramps on the right side creates barriers for pedestrians with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the crosswalk landing

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps and Sidewalk Paving
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps and pave the sidewalk on the right to provide a continuous, accessible pedestrian path.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection with a marked crosswalk but a lack of visible pedestrian-specific infrastructure such as signals or refuge islands. The expansive crossing distance and high-speed road geometry create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signals are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt surface could present a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway surface

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time remaining.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a marked crosswalk that lacks connecting sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps, terminating in a grassy area. The intersection is part of a large, multi-lane arterial system with high-speed vehicle traffic and no dedicated pedestrian signals, creating significant safety and accessibility barriers.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk on unpaved grassy shoulders or in the roadway to reach the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway and beyond the crosswalk

hazards.name: Inaccessible Crossing
hazards.description: The crosswalk terminates in grass with no curb ramps, making it unusable for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground at the edge of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no dedicated pedestrian signals, forcing users to rely on vehicular lights which may not provide sufficient crossing time.
hazards.location_in_image: Overhead at the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees on the right side block sight lines between waiting pedestrians and oncoming motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road near the intersection

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks to provide a safe, separated path for pedestrians connecting to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at the crosswalk to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve safety and predictability for crossing.
